{{Top|leg}}
'''Filing Stations''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. At least one Filing Station was present in every [[Tasari]] settlement, and was used to refill [[oxygen tank]]s with [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. Personal tanks cost one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] to refill, while vehicle tanks cost five credits.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
